text: The Upper Frostlands are a snow and ice-covered plain that comprise the eastern half of Azure Span, stretching from Vakthros and the Vakthros Range in the northeast to the Cobalt Assembly, Camp Antonidas, and Azure Archives in the west. On the northern edge, the frostlands are bordered from west to east by Camp Antonidas, Cobalt Assembly, the Fallen Course, Theron's Watch, and Winterpelt Hollow. The frostlands contain Grimtusk's Hideaway, Rhonin's Shield, Sylvern Plunge, and the Duck Cave. On the southern edge, the frostlands are bordered from east to west by the Lost Ruins and Forgotten Cavern, Rustpine Den and Camp Nowhere, Timbertooth Trail, and Zelthrak Outpost.
Unusual Suspects starts one weekly lockout after completing It Belongs in a Museum... Eventually, the Renown 24 chapter of the Dragonscale Expedition storyline.
__NOTOC__ Uranto the Swift is a hornstrider located in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Grand Hunts.
Urgent Stormwind Summons are provided by Agent Render for An Urgent Matter.
Unyielding Domain is an Augmentation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Tectonic Locus.
Upraised Headstone is sold for by Baron Sliver at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

__NOTOC__ Uthek the Wise is a centaur quest giver located in Gelkis Village in Desolace. She was the shaman of the Gelkis clan and was initially neutral to players. She would not offer any quests until she was friendly with the player. She has been missing since the Cataclysm, and seems likely to have passed away, given that Khan Shodo makes no mention of her.
Vaelastrasz the Corrupt is the second boss of Blackwing Lair. He was corrupted by Nefarian and now serves him unwillingly.

Vaean is a night elf enchanting vendor located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, standing next to Taladan, the enchanting trainer of Darnassus, and Aladrel Whitespire, one of the Shen'dralar Highborne magi. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

__NOTOC__ Uzzek is an orc located just southwest of Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens. He is a veteran of many battles. He was critically wounded during the Legion invasions, but an adventurer saved his life.

(exterior).]] Uther's Tomb is a monument dedicated to Uther the Lightbringer, at Sorrow Hill in what is now the Western Plaguelands - the only bastion of Light in a dying land. It is connected to the lower parts of Sorrow Hill by the Path of Uther. The grave is sacred to followers of the Light. High Priest Thel'danis is the caretaker of the tomb. During the Harvest Festival, Wagner Hammerstrike asks Alliance adventurers to honor Uther by placing offerings at his statue.
Uthan Stillwater is a tauren fishing trainer located on the banks of Stonebull Lake just west of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Vagash is a wendigo mob found on the overlook just west of Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. He terrorizes the local farms and ram herds. Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay the beast and bring her one of his fangs as proof.
Retail= |-| Classic= __NOTOC__ Valdred Moray is a Forsaken located in the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.
Vahlarriel Demonslayer is a night elf quest giver located at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

Valaar's Berth is a dock outside the Exodar on western Azuremyst Isle. Its architecture is night elvish. The elvish ship Elune's Blessing provides transport between Valaar's Berth and Rut'theran Village on Teldrassil via the Veiled Sea, connecting the Azuremyst Isles to the mainland Kalimdor and thus the rest of the world via. Before World of Warcraft: Cataclysm the ship ran to Auberdine in Darkshore. Night elves have set up a small camp just beyond Valaar's Berth. The druid trainer, Shalannius and Huntress Kella Nightbow are located here.
__NOTOC__ Vale Screechers are wind serpents located in Feralas. Once killed, their Screecher Spirits could originally be summoned with Yeh'kinya's Bramble.
Vale Moths are moth mobs found at the northern end of Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle.
Valadar Starsong is the 3rd quest in the The Lunar Festival quest chain.
Vagath is a nathrezim who was once loyal to Illidan Stormrage.
__NOTOC__ Vacillating Voidcallers are voidcallers found in the Void Ridge in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Valdred's Hands drop from Valdred Moray in Silverpine Forest.

Vakkiz the Windrager is one of four descendants of Terokk's ancient enemies who are being held by the Skettis talonpriests. You learn of their existence from a tome named Adversarial Bloodlines. Originally, you were asked to retrieve Vakkiz's Scale if you intended to summon and defeat Terokk. Open a skull pile at one of the red summoning portals in Skettis. If you have 10 Time-Lost Scrolls, you will be presented with a list of names. Select "Vakkiz the Windrager". The scrolls will be expended and Vakkiz will appear in a flash of lightning.

Utgarde Catacombs is a part of the Utgarde Keep area in Howling Fjord. The entrance is located on the western side of the keep in a small crevice across a bridge in Wyrmskull Village. After a long spiraling path, a large vrykul-built hallway can be found. This hall splits in to two wings; one side has Ares the Oathbound and the Harpoon Operation Manual, and the other further splits into a long hallway infested with undead and the Ring of Judgement where four Mini Bosses: Firjus the Soul Crusher, Jlarborn the Strategist, Oluf the Violent and Yorus the Flesh Harvester, can be fought. There are a few quests here, notably The Shining Light and The Ring of Judgment. Since the Vrykul are using the

Vaelan's Gift is provided as an objective for Seal of Ascension (2).

Valdania is a charismatic paladin. She could string together multiple holy strikes in a shining display of her holy fervor. She once attacked a creature with two holy strikes, the second attack dealt extra damage. On her third holy strike the extra damage doubled.
Vakkiz's Scale drops from Vakkiz the Windrager in Terokkar Forest.
Utopian Tunic of Elune is an epic leather chest armor for casters.
Uukkarnit is a tuskarr trade goods vendor found in Kamagua in Howling Fjord.
Val'kyr Watchers appear during the quest The Echo of Ymiron after using the Incense Burner in Wyrmskull Village. They patrol throughout the village and will pull the player out of the spirit world.
Val'kyr Soulclaimers are Val'kyr located in the spirit world of Wyrmskull Village in the Howling Fjord.

Val'kyr Battle-maidens watch over fresh death knights atop Acherus: The Ebon Hold alongside the Lich King. When death knights die in the instanced area around the Scarlet Enclave, they will come and resurrect the slain. (Once every 10 minutes.) During the Battle for the Ebon Hold shortly after the death knights are freed. They replace the normal Spirit Healers while in the zone.

Val'kyr are a type of ascended female vrykul. The original Val'kyr are warriors of the Light created to serve the Prime Designate Odyn by bringing the spirits of the glorious dead to his Halls of Valor. The Val'kyr of the Scourge acted as the Lich King's agents in the spirit world and were described by Thoralius the Wise as fearsome creatures made of pure nightmare. After the defeat of the Lich King, several Val'kyr came to serve the Forsaken under Sylvanas Windrunner. After the Banshee Queen's desertion of the Forsaken and the Horde, her remaining Val'kyr followed and returned to directly serving the Jailer's forces.
Valanar's Signet Ring is a quest reward from If Chaos Drives, Let Suffering Hold The Reins.
Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ Uzo Deathcaller is a jungle troll death knight found at Death's Rise in Icecrown.

Utamu is a jungle troll meat, fish and drink vendor located aboard Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown.

__NOTOC__ in the halls of Thane Ufrang the Mighty.]] Vaelen the Flayed can be found in Icecrown. He is a death knight who was first sent by Baron Sliver to invade Jotunheim, but he failed and his entire contingent got captured. He now asks the player for help to free his men. After being freed he is relocated to the Shadow Vault.
Uther's Tribute is provided as an objective for Honoring a Hero (Alliance).
Val'kyr Heralds are Val'kyr found circling the Spire of Icecrown Citadel.

The Val'kyr Guardian is a Val'kyr spawned when using damaging or healing spells while wielding Nibelung, which drops from Lady Deathwhisper 25. The Val'kyr has a 2% chance of spawning per attack done. Multiple Guardians can be summoned at once. The Val'kyr will despawn after 30 seconds.
Vaelan's Claw is a quest reward from General Drakkisath, Hand of Nefarian.
Vak is the Lookout of the Horde trading ship Orgath'ar. Despite heavy fog Vak was able to spot a Theramore ship not assisting the Oragth'ar while they were being attacked by pirates.

Valarya Riverrun was one of the two Sentinels, the other being Ayli Leafwhisper, who informed King Varian Wrynn and Lady Jaina Proudmoore about the slaughter of a night elf caravan in Ashenvale. Valarya blamed the Horde for this, when unknown to all it was the work of the Twilight Hammer.

The Vagash Pelt Vest is a quest reward from Protecting the Herd.
The Val'kyr Arbiter judges Thane Illskar after you slay him for Revenge for the Vargul.
Two Val'kyr Observer judge Halfdan the Ice-Hearted after you slay him for Stop the Ascension!.

.]] Val'kyr Shadowguards appear during Phase 2 of the Lich King fight at the Frozen Throne in Icecrown Citadel. They pick up raid members, carry them to the closest edge of the platform and drop them to their death.

Uyen Chow is a pandaren in the Chow Farmstead of Kun-Lai Summit. Her husband farmer Chow and herself agree to help the visiting adventurers, but first she sends them off to collect Root Vegetables and the Cast Iron Pot guarded by Cookie McYaungol.
Vaeldrin's Journal can be found at the Incursion in the Krasarang Wilds. It belongs to Lorekeeper Vaeldrin.

Val'sharah (sometimes spelled as Val'Sharah and pronounced "VAHL-shaw-raw") is a region in the northwestern area of the Broken Isles. It is covered by a thick forest, and is the cradle of night elven druidic culture. It is home to the World Tree Shaladrassil. The zone is currently contested by Xavius and his satyrs attempting to spread the corruption of the Emerald Nightmare.
Val Goldspade is a deceased goblin located at the Broken Precipice in .
Va'zik is a jungle troll follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

__NOTOC__ Val'zuun is a man'ari eredar informant of unknown origin found sitting in an alcove of the Underbelly Descent in Dalaran. He is one of the Uncrowned contacts that subtlety rogues in search of the Fangs of the Devourer speak to in order to learn the whereabouts of the eredar assassin Akaari Shadowgore, who wields the Fangs. Val'zuun tells the rogue that Akaari is already present in Dalaran, spying for her masters, but says that he won't reveal her exact location until the rogue brings him a rune of portals. The Valarjar Purification Crown dropped from Hymdall in the Halls of Valor.
Valarjar Insignias can drop from Vrykul Ancestral Chests in Stormheim and is also rewarded from Class Hall missions.
The Valarjar Ascendant Breastplate dropped from Odyn in the Halls of Valor.
Uther's Guard enhances Blessing of Freedom, Blessing of Protection, Blessing of Sacrifice and Blessing of Spellwarding. It is named after Uther the Lightbringer.
The Valarjar Cache is a quest reward from The Valarjar (quest).
Valdremar is a gnome appearing in series 2 of DC Direct's World of Warcraft action figures. He was part of a two-pack, also featuring Voyd.

Valdisdall is a small encampment and watch tower overlooking the village of Akstad and the Runewood in eastern Stormheim. It serves as a crossroads between the region's eastern landmass and the mainland. Valdisdall is inhabited by Valarjar vrykul loyal to Odyn, and serves as a base for much of their operations in Stormheim, particularly against the Burning Legion and the Sea-Witch Helya. Present at the site is the mysterious vrykul Havi, who may not be all he seems.
Valazar the Corruptor is a nathrezim that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.
The Valarjar Vendor List was sold by Xur'ios in Dalaran for .
Val'sharah is one of World of Warcraft: Legion level-up zones. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement That's Val'sharah Folks!.
Valdemar Stormseeker is a vrykul emissary and Valarjar's quartermaster found at Valdisdall in Stormheim.
The Vainglorious Draught is a reputation reward; you must be with Court of Farondis to purchase this item from Veridis Fallon in Azsuna for .
Vahu the Weathered is a Broken located on the bottom floor of the Fel Hammer in Mardum. As a researcher of the Illidari, he wrote the Tome of Fel Secrets.
Valarjar Soul Fragment drops from bosses in Trial of Valor and mobs in certain World Quests in Stormheim.
Valarjar Rune-Sigils drop from mobs in Halls of Valor. They can also be looted from Hymdall's Cache.
Valakar the Thirsty is a withered located in Farondale in Azsuna.
Valarjar Falconers are vrykul located in Halls of Valor. Friendly versions appear during the Fields of the Eternal Hunt scenario.
The Varlarjar Campaign (Warrior Campaign) is the main questline for the warrior class in the World of Warcraft: Legion expansion.
__NOTOC__ Vale Howlers are monkeys found all over Northern Stranglethorn.
Valarjar Warsingers are vrykul located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. They inform the Battlelord that Odyn requests an audience in Skyhold.

Val is a world that has long fallen to the Legion. The climate is way below freezing temperature and anyone caught in it will die in a matter of seconds. After being conquered by the Legion, the demons planted braziers to make the cold bearable. The Legion now uses it to hold their prisoners while inquisitors steal their secrets. In Legion, an Invasion Point connects Argus to this location. The Illidari were sent forth but they ended up frozen in place. Order champions then arrived under orders from Illidan Stormrage, freed the frozen Illidari, and repelled the Legion from Val.
Vaengir is a storm drake located in Stormheim. It is the mount of God-King Skovald.
Valarjar Stormwing can be rarely found in the Valarjar Strongbox, a reward from Supplies From the Valarjar.
__NOTOC__ Vadis is a wyrmtongue located in the Imperial Granary in Valley of the Four Winds during The Riddle of the Barrel.

Uuna's Doll is a rare drop from The Many-Faced Devourer at in the Antoran Wastes. Summoning the Many-Faced Devourer involves finding a Call of the Devourer and completing a ritual with it. See that article for more information.
Uzuul the Annihilator is a wrathguard who was taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons in Sha'tari Skymesa.
Val'kyr Vestments drop from Hildana Deathstealer in Icecrown.

Valarjar Spear-Sisters are female vrykul members of the Valarjar faction, who used their expertise as warriors in battle during the third invasion of the Burning Legion. They principally answer to Odyn, and the Battlelord of the Valarjar. Initially, the Spear-Sisters would be involved in the Assault on Broken Shore (as part of the Armies of Legionfall) based from Deliverance Point, where they fought alongside other Valarjar elements, as well as forces from the other Class Orders. Later, they would join in the Argus Campaign, and found themselves stationed on board the Vindicaar.
Val'sharah Druids are night elves found at various locations in Val'sharah.
Vale Falcons are falcons located at the North Pass Caverns in Drustvar.
Valarjar Shieldmaidens are vrykul located in the Halls of Valor, as well as in Niskara, the Fields of the Eternal Hunt scenario, and on the Broken Shore.
Valarjar Aspirants are vrykul located in the Halls of Valor and in Skyhold.

Val'kyr of Odyn are members of the Valarjar who personally serve the Keeper Odyn from his seat in the Halls of Valor. As val'kyr, they are responsible for collecting the spirits of valorous dead who have fallen in combat, and bringing them to Odyn's Halls for rebirth as Valarjar. Additionally, these val'kyr can also lead the charge against enemies themselves, as well as perform a multitude of other functions on and off the battlefield. While based from Skyhold and the Halls of Valor, Val'kyr of Odyn can also be found in every region of the Broken Isles, as part of the war against the Burning Legion.

Uther was the first of the paladins blessed by the Archbishop Faol, prior to the Second War. He is a weathered veteran, respected as one of the greatest warriors in human history. Though it has been many years since war endangered his beloved Lordaeron, Uther has never tired in his duty to protect his land from demi-human threats and social unrest. The great-hearted leader of the paladins is perhaps the greatest general the Alliance has ever known. Only his wish to see Arthas become worthy of his father's crown has kept him from retiring and taking his due rest.
Vadekius's Rest is a location in Drustvar. The skeletal remains of Vadekius are found here.
__NOTOC__ Vale Marmots are marmots located in Stormsong Valley.
Valarjar Thundercallers are vrykul located in the Halls of Valor.
Vale Bears are bears located in the Sylvan Vale of Val'sharah. During Out of the Woodwork, Bloodspike Needlers sneak up and ride them.
The Valarjar Strongbox is a quest reward from Supplies From the Valarjar.
Val'sharah Refugees are night elves located in Irongrove Retreat and Shal'Aran in Suramar, Azsuna, and Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.

Val'kyr Arena Masters are Val'kyr who oversee the Arena of Glory within Skyhold, the halls of the Valarjar. The arena exists to test the mettle of the warriors who call Skyhold home, with rewards to be had for the strongest and most valorous of combatants. With the arena situated as it is high above the clouds of Azeroth, the Arena Masters also catch anyone who may fall off the edge of the ring.
Vale Flutterby could be obtained by catching a Vale Flutterby using a Flutterby Collector.
V-300 Serial Plates drop from V-300 SENTRIES at the Abandoned Junkheap in Tiragarde Sound.
.]] Uu'nat, Harbinger of the Void is the second and final boss in the Crucible of Storms.
__NOTOC__ V-300 SENTRIES are mechanical wolves located at Abandoned Junkheap in Tiragarde Sound.
__NOTOC__ Uzan the Sandreaver is a sand troll located on the expedition isles.
The Val'kyr Horn is provided as an objective for They Will Know Fear.
